enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Vengeful: When its wielder is hit in battle, this item has a 10% chance to cause him or her to become full of anger and go into a Rage.
Humanoid Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to those that walk among us, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Humanoids.
Gashing 15: The edges of this weapon are sharpened beyond belief, dealing an additional 15d6 slashing damage on each critical hit.

Improved Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every second.
